anchor.quote: A system for optimizing the operations of a pipeline system
an optimization program, which when executed by the processor, is configured to
read input data, wherein the input data describes the pipeline system to be optimized
generate a population of solutions, wherein each solution in the population specifies a feasible production state for the pipeline system
evaluate each solution in the population of solutions
perform a genetic optimization process on the population until a termination condition specified by the input data is satisfied

select an optimized production solution from the population of solutions, wherein the optimized production solution has a highest evaluation, relative to the solutions in the population after the genetic optimization process is performed

generate, for the optimized production solution, an optimized pressure solution specifying an output pressure for one or more delivery points of the pipeline system and an input pressure for one or more production nodes of the pipeline system, using a direct pressure optimization process
the optimization program is configured to perform the genetic optimization process by
modifying at least one aspect of the feasible operational state specified by at least one solutions in the population
simulating the operation of the pipeline system, according to the operational state specified by the modified solution
evaluating the performance of the modified solution
adding the modified solution to the population
removing a solution from the population with the poorest evaluation, relative to the solutions in the population
the program is configured to modify the at least one aspect of the feasible operational state specified by at least one solution in the population by performing the steps of
selecting the at least one solution from the population to modify
modifying the at least one solution, according to the selected solution modification technique
the solution modification technique randomly modifies the least one aspect of the feasible operational state specified by the solution
the solution modification technique modifies the at least one solution according to a heuristic rule
the solution modification technique cross-breeds two or more solutions to generate the modified solution

modifying at least one aspect of the feasible operational state specified by at least one of the solutions in the population, comprises probabilistically selecting the one or more solutions, wherein a solution with a superior evaluation is more likely to be selected for modification than a solution with an inferior evaluation
specified by at least one of
is more likely to be selected for modification than
the termination conditions specified by the input data comprise the termination conditions include at least one of
a maximum number of solutions generated
a maximum amount of time spent
the generation of a solution that exceeds a specified evaluation

the optimization program is configured to generate a population of solutions by generating a first group of solutions and a second group of solutions, wherein the first group of solutions are generated according to heuristic rules and wherein the second group of solutions are generated using a random process
the input data is retrieved from a pipeline status database that stores a current operational state of the pipeline system
